HomeFaq.title: What should I know before converting?

banks.question: Which statements are supported?
banks.answer: We are checking the converter against several electronic bank statement layouts. We will list banks and layout variants as we verify them.

accuracy.question: Why should I review the conversion result?
accuracy.answer: The converter keeps table headers and cell text where it can. Complex layouts, blurred text, or uneven columns can leave rows marked "DISCREPANCY" or "UNVERIFIABLE". Check the Excel file against the original PDF before you use it.

quota.question: How many pages can I convert each day?
quota.answer: Anonymous users can convert {anonymousPages, plural, one {# page} other {# pages}} per day, and signed-in users can convert {authenticatedPages, plural, one {# page} other {# pages}} per day. Monthly plans include {standardPages, plural, one {# page} other {# pages}} for Standard, {professionalPages, plural, one {# page} other {# pages}} for Professional, and {enterprisePages, plural, one {# page} other {# pages}} for Enterprise. Before upload, your browser reads the PDF page count locally and asks this website for your remaining quota, without sending the PDF or consuming quota. The file is uploaded when you start conversion; the server still validates the file, pages and quota.

scans.question: Can I convert scanned or encrypted PDFs?
scans.answer: Professional and Enterprise can attempt scanned PDFs with AI. Other plans require a text layer. Password-protected files are not supported on any plan.

storage.question: Are my PDF, Excel file, or transactions saved?
storage.answer: The server keeps no persistent history of PDFs, exports or transactions. This tab’s session storage temporarily holds the filename, extracted result, selected merchant columns and alias mappings, including confirmed names, for preview, refresh recovery and download. Starting another conversion or clearing the result clears these records; mappings are not reused across files. Keep your original PDF and downloads.

failure.question: What happens if conversion fails?
failure.answer: If conversion fails, the page shows an error and does not offer an invalid Excel file. Failed conversions do not use quota. Partial results use quota based on the PDF page count.

ai.question: When is AI parsing used?
ai.answer: Every conversion starts with regular parsing. Only Professional and Enterprise with a valid entitlement fall back to AI parsing when regular parsing fails, is unavailable or yields no reviewable transactions. Usable partial results do not trigger fallback. Fallback sends the complete PDF and its filename to the AI parsing provider; see the privacy policy for processing details. Scans and AI results still require checking against the original.

Terms.title: Terms of service
Terms.intro: This service is operated by ReAvid Ltd and provided through <site>{domain}</site>. Read these terms and the privacy policy before using the conversion and subscription services.
Terms.availability: PDF to Excel conversion and Creem, PayPal or Waffo subscriptions are provided according to the current page state. Plan prices and availability may change with service configuration.

service.title: Service scope
service.body: The service organizes transaction information from supported bank statement PDFs into Excel files for download and review. Supported banks, file types, and processing limits are described on the service page. We do not provide bank account connections, banking services, or financial, tax, or legal advice. Regular parsing runs first. Professional and Enterprise with a valid entitlement can fall back automatically to the AI parsing provider when regular parsing fails, is unavailable or yields no reviewable transactions, including attempts to convert scans. Usable partial results do not trigger fallback.

authorization.title: Authorization to upload files
authorization.body: Upload only statements that you are authorized to use and process. Make sure your upload and processing of personal or financial information comply with applicable law and your obligations to other people. Do not upload files obtained without authorization.

accuracy.title: Reviewing conversion results
accuracy.body: Statement layout, clarity, and content can affect extraction. Results may contain missing, duplicated, or incorrectly identified fields. Compare the Excel file with the original statement before bookkeeping, filing, submitting materials, or making another decision. AI parsing and scan conversion may also produce errors or omissions. Tables shown during generation are temporary previews; passing final validation does not guarantee complete accuracy. Merchant normalization records names you confirm manually; it does not verify merchant identity or change the original text, source references or extraction risks. Risk filters affect only the preview; exports include all transactions in the result.

quota.title: Conversion quotas
quota.body: Anonymous users can convert {anonymousPages, plural, one {# PDF page} other {# PDF pages}} per day, and signed-in free users can convert {authenticatedPages, plural, one {# PDF page} other {# PDF pages}} per day. Standard includes {standardPages, plural, one {# page} other {# pages}} per month, Professional includes {professionalPages, number}, and Enterprise includes {enterprisePages, number}. Daily quota resets in UTC and plan quota follows the current Creem, PayPal or Waffo billing period. Failed conversions do not use quota; partial results count PDF pages. Before upload, your browser reads the PDF page count locally and asks this website for your remaining quota, without sending the PDF or consuming quota. The file is uploaded when you start conversion; the server still validates the file, pages and quota.

subscription.title: Subscriptions and payment
subscription.body: Standard, Professional, and Enterprise renew monthly at the price shown before purchase. Creem is our payment provider and Merchant of Record (the legal seller for the transaction), handling payments, applicable taxes, and payment receipts. You are charged only after confirming the purchase. Creem sends subscription, renewal, and payment failure information to this service. Cancel automatic renewal from your website account; paid access remains available until the confirmed billing period ends. For PayPal checkout, ReAvid Ltd is the seller and PayPal processes subscription payments and related account information under its terms and privacy policy. PayPal is not the Merchant of Record for this service. For Waffo checkout, Waffo acts as Merchant of Record and handles payments and applicable taxes. Waffo prices exclude tax; the final amount is shown at checkout. Available payment providers depend on the purchase options currently shown on the website.

refunds.title: Refund policy
refunds.body: Subscriptions to this service are digital products and are non-refundable after purchase, including initial subscription payments and automatic renewals. Unused page quota or remaining subscription time cannot be refunded, redeemed for cash, or refunded on a prorated basis. Please review the plan, price, and service limits before purchasing.
refunds.cancellation: Cancelling automatic renewal only stops future renewal charges and does not refund fees already paid. Paid access and remaining quota stay available until the confirmed billing period ends. Unused quota expires at that time and does not roll over.
refunds.rights: Where applicable law requires otherwise, those legal requirements apply.

files.title: Files and downloads
files.body: Excel, CSV, JSON, Markdown, TSV and HTML exports are generated in your browser from the current final result, including any merchant names you confirm. The server keeps no persistent history of PDFs, extracted transactions or export files. The filename, result and merchant mappings are temporarily stored in this tab’s session for preview, refresh recovery and download. Keep your original statement and downloads; the service offers no historical re-downloads after the current flow ends.

prohibited.title: Prohibited misuse
prohibited.body: Do not use the service to forge or misrepresent financial records, infringe another person's rights, commit fraud, distribute malicious files, or bypass quotas, security measures, or access limits. We may restrict service access for illegal or clearly abusive activity.

rights.title: Ownership
rights.body: You retain the rights you have to files and their contents. Uploading a file gives us only the permission needed to process it for the current conversion; it does not transfer ownership. Rights in the website software, interface, and brand remain with their lawful owners.

liability.title: Availability and liability

To the extent allowed by law, we are not liable for indirect losses caused by failure to review results, unsupported formats, or service interruptions. This does not exclude liability or user rights that cannot be excluded by law.

metadata.title: Privacy policy | StatementXL
metadata.description: How bank statements, AI parsing, temporary browser results, and account, parsing operations, quota and billing data are processed.

Privacy.title: Privacy policy
Privacy.intro: ReAvid Ltd operates <site>{domain}</site>. This policy explains how we handle information when you use the conversion and Creem, PayPal or Waffo subscription services.
Privacy.availability: This policy applies to the currently available PDF to Excel conversion, account sign-in, and Creem, PayPal or Waffo subscription features.

documents.title: Bank statements and conversion content
documents.body: Your PDF may contain sensitive names, account numbers, transaction dates, amounts, balances and descriptions. We process PDFs, extracted transactions and export content only to complete your requested conversion and download, not for advertising or unrelated purposes. Third-party processing during AI fallback is explained below. Before upload, your browser reads the PDF page count locally and asks this website for your remaining quota, without sending the PDF or consuming quota. The file is uploaded when you start conversion; the server still validates the file, pages and quota.

accountData.title: Account, quota, and billing information
accountData.body: When you sign in with Google, Supabase stores the identity and account details needed to provide account services. After a subscription is activated, we store its status, plan, Creem, PayPal or Waffo subscription identifier, billing period, payer email, and a snapshot of the website account email at purchase. Creem, PayPal or Waffo handles payment information. These records do not contain PDF originals, extracted transactions, or Excel content. For signed-in users, we also store the account ID, email snapshot, record time, last selected parsing method, conversion status, and reasons for parsing failures and AI fallback for each parsing attempt to investigate failures. These records contain no file names, file contents, transactions, or model output. To create checkout, we send the selected plan and an account identifier to the chosen payment provider. Creem and Waffo also receive the website account email; PayPal handles payment details through its own account flow. Billing metadata may also include provider plan and payer identifiers, payment amount and currency, original amount, discount amount and identifier, and payment event identifiers.

technicalData.title: Necessary technical information
technicalData.body: To operate the website, maintain security, and investigate failures, we may process access time, IP address, browser or device information, and error records that do not contain statement content. To measure visits, Google Analytics and Pageview may receive access time, IP address, and browser or device information. We do not send bank statements, extracted transactions, or generated Excel content to these analytics services.

purposes.title: Processing purposes
purposes.body: Information is used only to complete conversions and downloads, measure and improve site visits, manage accounts and quotas, provide subscriptions and billing, respond to requests, maintain service security, and meet applicable legal obligations.

retention.title: Retention
retention.documents: This website uses PDFs, extracted transactions and generated export content only for the current conversion and download, without writing them to a persistent database, object storage or file history. No files are kept for later downloads after processing. Data received by the AI parsing provider is subject to its own retention and processing rules.
retention.metadata: Account, quota, and billing metadata is retained only as long as needed to provide the service or meet applicable legal obligations. It is deleted or anonymized when no longer needed according to the actual system and legal requirements. The account email stored at purchase is part of the subscription record. Parsing operational metadata follows the same retention principles; associated parsing records are deleted when the account is deleted.

providers.title: Providers and international processing
providers.body: Account sign-in uses Google and Supabase. Creem is our payment provider and Merchant of Record (the legal seller for the transaction). It processes subscription payments, applicable taxes, payment receipts, and refunds required by applicable law, and synchronizes subscription status with this service. Site visit measurement uses Google Analytics and Pageview, which may process technical visit information under their applicable terms and privacy policies. Creem may process payment and account information under its applicable terms and privacy policy. If processing occurs across borders, we will apply the safeguards required by applicable law and describe the actual arrangement. We do not sell bank statements or transaction information. For PayPal checkout, ReAvid Ltd is the seller and PayPal processes subscription payments and related account information under its terms and privacy policy. PayPal is not the Merchant of Record for this service. When you select Waffo, it acts as payment provider and Merchant of Record, processes payment and account information, and sends subscription updates to this service.

storage.title: Browser storage
storage.body: The website uses browser local storage to remember appearance preferences and necessary session cookies to maintain sign-in. Analytics services may also use cookies or similar browser identifiers to measure visits. You can manage local storage and cookies through your browser settings. The current conversion also temporarily stores the filename and extracted results in browser session storage for preview and download. This is not server-side persistent file history. Selected merchant source columns, alias mappings and confirmed merchant names are also stored with the current result in this tab’s session storage. They can be restored on refresh and are cleared with the result when you start another conversion or clear the current one. They are not saved on the server or reused across files; merchant normalization makes no additional model request.

security.title: Information security
security.body: We use reasonable measures appropriate to the sensitivity of the information being processed, but internet transmission and software systems cannot guarantee absolute security. Protect your original statements, downloaded Excel files, and account access details.

rights.title: Your privacy rights
rights.body: Depending on the laws that apply where you live, you may have the right to access, correct, delete, or obtain a copy of personal information, or to object to or restrict certain processing. Contact us using the email below. Where applicable, you may also complain to a regulator. We will verify and handle requests under applicable law.

terms.title: Related terms
terms.body: Using the service also requires reading the <link>terms of service</link>.

changes.title: Policy updates
changes.body: We may update this policy when service features, processing methods, or legal requirements change and will show the update date on this page. We will notify users of material changes as required by applicable law.

contact.title: Contact us
contact.body: For questions about information processing or to exercise applicable privacy rights, contact ReAvid Ltd at <link>{email}</link>.

aiParsing.title: AI parsing and third-party processing
aiParsing.body: Professional and Enterprise with a valid entitlement start with regular parsing. If it fails, is unavailable or yields no reviewable transactions, the system automatically sends the complete PDF and its filename to the AI parsing provider to extract transactions for this conversion, including attempts to process scans. Usable partial results do not trigger fallback. Files may contain sensitive names, account numbers and transactions. Processing by the AI parsing provider is governed by its terms and privacy policy. This website does not retain PDFs, extracted transactions, model output or export content as persistent history. This boundary does not mean the AI parsing provider retains no data; we make no additional guarantee about its retention periods or use of data for model training.

Geo.browserTitle: What is temporarily stored in my browser?
Geo.browserAnswer: The server keeps no persistent history of PDFs, exports or transactions. This tab’s session storage temporarily holds the filename, extracted result, selected merchant columns and alias mappings, including confirmed names, for preview, refresh recovery and download. Starting another conversion or clearing the result clears these records; mappings are not reused across files. Keep your original PDF and downloads.
Geo.metadataTitle: Which account and billing data is retained?
Geo.siteTitle: Where can I find the website information?
Geo.siteAnswer: StatementXL converts bank statement PDFs for review, with risk filtering, manual merchant normalization and six export formats. The homepage contains conversion, plans and FAQs; the product overview, pricing and privacy documents describe capabilities and limits. Use the account page to manage subscriptions, the result page to review and download, and the contact link for support.
Geo.agentsDescription: Read the official product information in Markdown.
Geo.chatDescription: Ask an AI assistant about StatementXL using our official sources.
Geo.prompt: Visit the official StatementXL information: {fullUrl}. If you need more detail, read {indexUrl} and follow the relevant document links. Answer in {language}: explain the product features, usage steps, file limits, data handling, free quotas and subscription prices, and cite source links. If you cannot access a source or it does not answer a question, say so clearly and do not guess.
Geo.metadataAnswer: Necessary account, quota and billing metadata is retained to operate the service. Manage your subscription in your account and Creem, PayPal or Waffo.
Geo.analyticsAnswer: Google Analytics and Pageview may process technical visit information. Bank statements, extracted transactions and Excel content are not sent to these analytics services.
Geo.merchantTitle: How can I normalize merchant names?
Geo.merchantAnswer: For each table in the final result, select a name or description column, group identical source text across tables in this file, and manually confirm, rename or remove merchant aliases. Original text, order, source references and extraction risks stay unchanged; no merchant identity is inferred and no additional model request is made. Confirmed names and a separate normalization status appear in the preview and all six export formats. In JSON, these fields are merchantName and merchantNormalizationStatus; unassigned names are null with status unassigned, and assigned names have status confirmed. Mappings stay in this tab’s session with the result and are not reused for another file. Removing all mappings restores the original export fields.

Landing.downloadText: Download Excel, or choose CSV, JSON, Markdown, TSV or HTML. CSV and TSV downloads contain one file per table, including risk and source fields. Adjust columns to your accounting software's requirements; these are not dedicated QBO or Xero files.

Landing.bankDownloadTitle: How to download a {bank} statement PDF
Landing.historyQuestion: How far back can I download {bank} statements?
Landing.formatsQuestion: Can I download formats other than Excel?

pdf.label: Bank statement PDF to Excel
pdf.title: Convert a bank statement PDF to Excel
pdf.intro: Use StatementXL to extract transactions from a bank statement PDF, compare the preview with your original and download Excel with risk flags. Convert {anonymousPages} page per day without signing in, or {authenticatedPages} pages when signed in. Keep your original statement for verification.

chase.label: Chase statement to Excel
chase.title: Convert a Chase bank statement to Excel
chase.intro: Download your Chase statement PDF and upload it to StatementXL to review transactions and download Excel. You get {anonymousPages} free page per day without signing in, or {authenticatedPages} when signed in. Check extracted rows against the original before using them.
chase.availability: Chase provides access to up to seven years of statements, depending on your account type. Check the years available for your account in Statements & documents; this is not a promise that every account has seven years of records.
chase.download: On chase.com, sign in and open the Main Menu. Choose Statements & documents, select the year and account, then use the Open or Save icon beside the statement. Save the original PDF rather than a screenshot or scan.
chase.details:
In Chase Mobile, open Profile & Settings, select Statements & documents within Document manager, then Statements. Choose your account, year and statement to open the PDF.

An account activity download is separate from a monthly statement PDF. Check the bank's current export options and available dates; we have not verified a fixed activity export window or a credit card CSV feature.

bofa.label: Bank of America statement to Excel
bofa.title: Convert a Bank of America statement to Excel
bofa.intro: Get your Bank of America statement PDF and upload it to StatementXL to check the extracted transactions and download Excel. Convert {anonymousPages} free page per day anonymously, or {authenticatedPages} when signed in. Download older requested statements promptly and keep the original PDF.
bofa.availability: Bank of America lets you view, print and download up to 18 months of statements with check images directly. Older copies can be requested for up to seven years back. Do not apply these periods to every credit card product without checking the account's available documents.
bofa.download: Sign in to Online Banking. Under the Accounts tab, open Statements & Documents, select the account and statement period, then view and save the statement PDF. For older copies, use Request statements in the same area.
bofa.detailsTitle: Requesting older Bank of America statements
bofa.details:
Requested electronic statement copies are free. They are generally available 24–36 hours after the request and remain accessible for seven days, so save them promptly.

Paper statement copies are mailed 7–10 business days after a request. Prefer the electronic PDF: a paper copy needs scanning, and only Professional and Enterprise can attempt scans through AI fallback.

wellsFargo.label: Wells Fargo statement to Excel
wellsFargo.title: Convert a Wells Fargo statement to Excel
wellsFargo.intro: Save your Wells Fargo statement PDF and use StatementXL to preview transactions, check risk flags and download Excel. Convert {anonymousPages} free page daily without signing in, or {authenticatedPages} when signed in. Statement availability varies by account type, so save the documents you need.
wellsFargo.availability: Online availability depends on the product: up to seven years for deposit, home mortgage, trust and managed investment accounts; up to two years for credit cards, home equity lines of credit, personal loans and lines of credit; and up to twelve months for auto loans. After account closure, statements may remain available for approximately ninety days.
wellsFargo.download: Sign in to Wells Fargo Online and open Statements & Documents. Choose your account and the available statement period, open the PDF and save it with a clear filename. If a closed account's documents are unavailable online, contact Wells Fargo for copies.
wellsFargo.detailsTitle: Wells Fargo business and credit card statements
wellsFargo.details:
Business Online provides documents for eligible business accounts. The advertised availability of up to seven years is subject to product-specific limits; it does not mean all business statements are retained that long.

Credit card statements are available for up to two years, so save them before they leave the online window.

scanned.label: Scanned bank statement to Excel
scanned.title: Convert a scanned bank statement to Excel
scanned.intro: Turn a paper or scanned statement PDF into reviewable transactions with StatementXL. Professional and Enterprise can attempt scans through AI fallback after regular parsing cannot produce usable transactions. Success is not guaranteed; compare the results with your original before downloading Excel.
scanned.planNote: Scanned PDFs require Professional or Enterprise and available page quota. Anonymous, free and Standard access requires a text layer. Use the plan comparison below to choose the appropriate parsing capability.
scanned.requirementsTitle: Which plans can attempt scanned statements?
scanned.requirements: Professional and Enterprise allow AI fallback. Regular parsing runs first; eligible failures can trigger AI, while usable partial results stay with regular parsing. Purchasing a plan does not guarantee that a particular scan can be read.
scanned.preparation: Scan complete pages in order, keep dates and amounts sharp, and avoid cropped edges, shadows and rotated pages. Upload a single PDF within the displayed limits. JPG or PNG images need to be combined into a PDF first; prefer the bank's original text PDF when available.
scanned.limitationsTitle: Review AI results and data handling
scanned.limitations: Check transaction count, dates, amount direction and balances against the original. OK means no issue detected, not guaranteed accuracy. AI fallback sends the complete PDF and filename to an external parsing provider under its policies. Password-protected files are unsupported. Failed conversions do not use quota; partial results use the PDF page count.

upload.title: Choose an eligible plan and upload
upload.text: Sign in with an active Professional or Enterprise plan and available quota, then upload one scanned PDF up to {megabytes} MB and {pages} pages.

review.title: Review the extracted transactions
review.text: Wait for final checks, compare all transactions with the PDF, and resolve DISCREPANCY and UNVERIFIABLE flags before using the data.

download.title: Download the reviewed results
download.text: Download Excel or another supported format. Keep the original and the downloaded file: StatementXL does not provide persistent file history.

quickbooks.label: Bank statement PDF to QuickBooks
quickbooks.title: Prepare bank statement transactions for QuickBooks Online
quickbooks.intro: Convert your PDF in StatementXL, review the transactions, then prepare a three- or four-column CSV for QuickBooks Online. This is a manual import workflow: StatementXL does not connect to your QuickBooks account or generate dedicated QBO files. QuickBooks also offers its own PDF and image import options.
quickbooks.planNote: Text PDFs can use the free daily quota; larger workloads can use a subscription. Scanned PDFs require Professional or Enterprise. Compare the configured prices and page quotas below.
quickbooks.planCta: Compare page quotas and parsing plans
quickbooks.requirementsTitle: Prepare a clean CSV for QuickBooks
quickbooks.requirements: Use Date, Description, Amount, or Date, Description, Credit, Debit. Copy reviewed transactions into a new sheet; remove balance, risk, source and summary columns from the import copy. Keep the full StatementXL export separately for checking. Use one date format, plain decimal amounts and blank unused amount cells.
quickbooks.preparation: Intuit's US guide recommends dd/mm/yyyy, English files up to 350 KB, and no more than 1,000 transaction lines per upload. Split larger files into non-overlapping batches. For a bank-account three-column CSV, payments are negative and deposits positive. Credit-card statements can use different signs: select the actual credit-card account and check the preview.
quickbooks.limitations: In QuickBooks Online, go to All apps → Accounting → Bank transactions → Upload from file. Choose the correct account, map the columns and date format, review the selected transactions, then confirm the import. Check existing transactions to prevent duplicates; match, categorize and reconcile afterward. Screens and availability may vary by account or region. CSV preparation here is optional: Intuit also documents direct PDF/image uploads.
quickbooks.stepsTitle: From statement PDF to a reviewed QuickBooks import

upload.title: Convert the statement PDF
upload.text: Upload one PDF up to {megabytes} MB and {pages} pages. Use a text PDF on free or Standard access; Professional and Enterprise can attempt scans.

review.title: Check and export transactions
review.text: Review risk flags against the original, then download Excel or CSV. Keep the export with risk and source information as your reference.

download.title: Prepare three or four columns
download.text: Create a separate CSV with only the required fields. Normalize dates and amount direction, remove totals and extra columns, and split batches within Intuit's upload limits.

import.title: Upload and reconcile in QuickBooks
import.text: Upload the CSV to the correct account, map the fields and review before confirming. Avoid duplicate transactions, then match, categorize and reconcile in QuickBooks.

quickbooks.examplesNote: Synthetic examples follow Intuit's bank-account sample: payment is negative in Amount, or positive in Credit; deposit is positive in Amount, or in Debit. Headers and sample descriptions remain in English for the import file. Empty cells stay blank. Check your target account's preview; do not apply these signs blindly to credit cards.

hsbc.label: HSBC UK statement to Excel
hsbc.title: Convert an HSBC UK personal GBP statement to Excel
hsbc.intro: Review a UK personal current-account PDF with the original alongside the export. This guide uses HSBC’s official statement explanation; it is not a verified parser-support claim.
hsbc.availability: This page concerns HSBC UK personal GBP current accounts, not other HSBC countries, business accounts or credit cards. Statement formats vary; inspect your own file and the extracted rows.
hsbc.download: Download the original PDF through HSBC online banking or its app. Keep all numbered sheets in order and retain the original for comparison. Use a native transaction export instead if it already meets your needs.
hsbc.detailsTitle: Account summary, sheet numbers and abbreviations
hsbc.details: HSBC describes a summary at the top right with opening balance, payments in, payments out, closing balance and overdraft limit, alongside account identifiers. These totals are not individual transactions. Sheet numbers help keep a multi-page statement in order. CR means credit, DR debit, DD Direct Debit, SO standing order and TRF transfer. Match abbreviations and wrapped descriptions to the original; do not infer a fixed transaction-column order from this guide.

docuclipper.title: StatementXL vs DocuClipper: choose by the work you need to finish
docuclipper.intro: Compare a focused PDF-to-spreadsheet workflow with a broader financial-document platform. This is a source-based comparison written by StatementXL, not an independent speed or accuracy test.

sections.title: When DocuClipper is a better fit
sections.text: DocuClipper advertises bank, credit-card and brokerage statements, invoices, receipts and checks, plus QBO export, batch processing, API and webhooks. Those capabilities are useful when a firm needs several document types or an automated intake pipeline. Verify the required integration and plan with DocuClipper before purchasing.

sections.title: When StatementXL is a better fit
sections.text: Choose StatementXL when you want to upload one PDF, inspect the extracted rows and download a spreadsheet. Exports retain risk reasons and source locations; OK, DISCREPANCY and UNVERIFIABLE describe the evidence available for each row. Excel, CSV, TSV, JSON, Markdown and HTML are available. The service has no QBO export or accounting connection.

sections.title: Compare a representative file before deciding
sections.text: Use the same permitted sample and review transaction count, dates, amounts, direction and multiline descriptions. Compare the total workflow cost, including review time and each plan’s limits. We have not run a head-to-head benchmark and do not repeat a vendor’s accuracy claim as an independently established result.

faq.question: Does StatementXL replace every DocuClipper workflow?
faq.answer: No. It is a narrower option for reviewing and exporting one statement PDF at a time. DocuClipper’s advertised document coverage, batch processing and integrations may suit a different workload.

alternatives.title: DocuClipper alternatives: compare native exports, StatementXL and Nanonets
alternatives.intro: The useful alternative depends on whether you need a spreadsheet, an accounting import file or a repeatable document-processing workflow. Start with the bank’s own export when it is available.

sections.title: Try a native transaction download first
sections.text: If online banking offers a CSV or Excel download for the required period, use it before converting a PDF. Check whether it includes the booked date, description, amount and required account or currency. A native export and an official PDF statement serve different purposes; keep the original PDF when supporting evidence is needed.

sections.title: Compare three different workflows
sections.text: StatementXL focuses on one-PDF conversion with row-level risk and source references. DocuClipper advertises broader financial-document extraction, batch processing and accounting-oriented exports. Nanonets offers configurable automation, API access and workflow blocks. A small manual job and a high-volume integration have different requirements.

sections.title: Evaluate the complete handoff
sections.text: Check the output required by your destination software, the available plan, file limits, privacy terms and review effort. StatementXL exports require manual preparation for accounting imports. Vendor features and prices can change; the linked official pages are the source for current commercial terms.

faq.question: Which alternative should I try first?
faq.answer: Try the bank’s native export first. If only a PDF is available, choose a tool by the required output and review workflow, then check it with a representative file.

nanonets.title: StatementXL vs Nanonets: a statement export or an automation workflow?
nanonets.intro: StatementXL focuses on inspectable statement exports. Nanonets offers document-processing and automation workflows. This comparison uses official descriptions; it is not a comparative accuracy test.

sections.title: Where Nanonets has an advantage
sections.text: Nanonets advertises data extraction, API access, email integration and cloud-storage connectors. Higher-tier offerings include ERP and database integrations and configurable workflow blocks. This breadth can matter when extraction is one step in a larger business process. Confirm the capabilities and terms for your specific workflow.

sections.title: Where StatementXL fits
sections.text: StatementXL is designed for one PDF at a time and downloadable Excel, CSV and other review formats. Risk labels and original source positions help you inspect uncertain rows. Scanned statements require an eligible plan and available quota. There is no public extraction API, bulk intake or direct Nanonets-style workflow automation.

sections.title: Compare costs using the right unit
sections.text: Nanonets describes credit-based pricing for workflow block runs, while StatementXL’s paid plans use monthly PDF-page quotas. Credits, block runs and pages are not interchangeable units. Evaluate a complete job, including manual review, rather than deriving a per-page comparison from unlike plan units.

faq.question: Has StatementXL been proven more accurate than Nanonets?
faq.answer: No. We have not run a controlled head-to-head evaluation. The public sample report only measures our local parser on the stated samples.

xero.title: Bank statement PDF to Xero: prepare and review a CSV import
xero.intro: Use this manual workflow when the statement you need is a PDF. Prefer the bank’s native CSV if available. StatementXL does not connect to Xero or create accounting entries.

sections.title: Prepare a separate import copy
sections.text: Convert the PDF and compare the result against the original. Keep the full export with risk and source columns as your review copy. For the import copy, use Xero’s regional template: Date and Amount are required. Put income and expenses in one Amount column, with income positive and expenses negative; a decimal comma is not accepted for amounts.

sections.title: Map, preview and reconcile
sections.text: In Xero, open Accounting → Bank accounts and choose Import a Statement for the correct account. Upload the CSV, map the fields and confirm the date format. Remove opening/closing balance columns, account numbers and blank rows from the import copy. Review the preview, complete the import, then reconcile statement lines with existing transactions.

sections.title: Avoid account and period overlap
sections.text: Create one file per bank account and currency. Keep consistent dates, preserve useful payee/description/reference fields, and inspect overlaps with bank feeds or earlier imports. Xero also has other statement-import options; CSV is a reviewable option, not a claim that Xero cannot accept PDFs.

faq.question: Is the downloaded CSV immediately ready for Xero?
faq.answer: No. StatementXL retains original columns and adds review fields. Prepare a copy in Xero’s required format and confirm the column mapping before importing.

wave.title: Bank statement PDF to Wave: review and upload transactions
wave.intro: A manual CSV workflow for Wave users in the United States and Canada. Convert only when a usable native bank export is unavailable, then verify the account and amount direction in Wave.

sections.title: Keep a review copy and an import copy
sections.text: Check the extracted dates, descriptions, amounts and risk flags against the PDF. Keep the original export for review. In an import copy, remove balance summaries, blank rows and risk/source columns that are not transaction fields. Do not combine different accounts or currencies.

sections.title: Use Wave’s import preview
sections.text: In Wave, go to Accounting → Transactions → More → Upload transactions. Select the statement and destination account. Confirm the date, amount and description columns in the preview before selecting Upload my statement. Wave distinguishes checking deposits from credit-card charges during amount selection; verify the direction rather than assuming one mapping fits both.

sections.title: Check existing transactions first
sections.text: Compare the period with any connected bank feed and earlier uploads. Avoid importing the same transaction twice, then categorize and reconcile the imported transactions. This guide does not add a Wave connection, automatic categorization or a dedicated Wave export to StatementXL.

faq.question: Should I upload a PDF directly through StatementXL to Wave?
faq.answer: No. These are separate services. Download and review the data, prepare a CSV copy, then perform the upload and field confirmation inside Wave.

sage.title: Bank statement PDF to Sage Accounting UK: prepare a CSV
sage.intro: This guide covers the UK Sage Accounting bank-statement import. It does not describe Sage 50 US, Sage Intacct or a direct StatementXL integration.

sections.title: Choose the four-column layout deliberately
sections.text: Sage’s four-column CSV format uses Date, Description, Money in, Money out in that order. After conversion, prepare a separate import copy with those columns. Keep the full export and its risk/source information for review; do not rename a balance column as a transaction amount.

sections.title: Check amounts and import into the right bank account
sections.text: Separate incoming and outgoing money according to the actual account statement. Use consistent dates and follow the current Sage format requirements linked below. In Banking, select the relevant account and import statement, then check the preview and map fields where prompted.

sections.title: Complete the accounting review
sections.text: Check overlapping periods and transactions already received through a bank feed. Review categories and reconciliation in Sage after importing. StatementXL does not assign Sage nominal codes, connect accounts or guarantee that a raw conversion is ready to import.

faq.question: Does this CSV work for every Sage product?
faq.answer: No. This page is for UK Sage Accounting. Use the documentation for your exact product and region before preparing an import.

loan.title: Organize bank statements for a loan application
loan.intro: Use a spreadsheet to organize and check statement transactions while retaining the original bank-issued PDFs. The lender decides which documents, periods and explanations it accepts.

sections.title: Start with the lender’s document request
sections.text: List the requested accounts, statement periods and currencies. Obtain complete bank-issued PDFs, including all pages. Record any missing period and ask the lender how to address it. A converted spreadsheet is a working aid and does not replace the lender’s requested statement evidence.

sections.title: Build a traceable review sheet
sections.text: Convert each PDF separately and check dates, descriptions, amount direction, transaction count and opening/closing balances. Preserve source references and investigate flagged rows. Use a separate notes column to explain transfers or unusual entries without changing the original transaction text.

sections.title: Keep evidence and explanations separate
sections.text: Keep the original PDFs, reviewed exports and supporting explanations together. Share only through the lender’s approved channel. Do not edit records to improve apparent income or conceal transactions. StatementXL does not assess creditworthiness or guarantee application approval.

faq.question: Will a StatementXL spreadsheet be accepted by my lender?
faq.answer: Acceptance depends on the lender. Ask which original statements and supporting files are required; conversion alone is not verification or approval.

tax.title: Organize bank statement transactions for tax preparation
tax.intro: A review workflow for preparing records, with US IRS recordkeeping guidance as the reference. A bank transaction alone does not establish a tax deduction or replace supporting receipts.

sections.title: Collect records by account and period
sections.text: Gather complete statements, receipts, invoices and other relevant records. Keep business and personal accounts identifiable, and note missing periods. The IRS recommends a recordkeeping system that clearly shows income and expenses and retains supporting documents.

sections.title: Review the extraction before categorizing
sections.text: Convert one PDF at a time. Check dates, description, amount direction and flagged rows against the original. Keep the full export with source information, and categorize transactions in a separate working copy. Distinguish transfers, refunds and loan proceeds from ordinary revenue or spending before calculating totals.

sections.title: Resolve questions with a tax professional
sections.text: Match entries to supporting evidence and compare totals with the original statements. Retain unresolved items instead of treating them as automatically deductible. Tax rules and retention duties vary by jurisdiction; StatementXL provides extraction, not a tax return, tax calculation or tax advice.

faq.question: Can I treat every outgoing transaction as a deduction?
faq.answer: No. Eligibility depends on the transaction, supporting evidence and applicable tax rules. Review uncertain items with a qualified tax professional.

catchup.title: Catch-up bookkeeping: turn missing statement periods into a review queue
catchup.intro: When months of records need attention, first establish which accounts and periods are missing. Conversion helps prepare transaction data; reconciliation and accounting decisions still need review.

sections.title: Make an account-by-month checklist
sections.text: List the accounts, currencies and periods to complete. Mark available statements, missing pages and transactions already imported through bank feeds. Obtain the missing original statements before attempting to fill gaps from memory. Start from the last reconciled closing balance.

sections.title: Work one statement at a time
sections.text: Convert each PDF separately, keep the original and review flagged rows. Compare transaction counts, dates, amounts and direction. Store a reviewed copy with source references; keep category decisions and merchant normalization separate from the bank’s original wording. StatementXL does not process a folder as a batch.

sections.title: Close each period before moving on
sections.text: Check for overlaps, duplicate uploads and internal transfers, then import a prepared copy into the destination system. Reconcile the ending balance to the statement and carry that verified balance into the next period. Track unresolved items explicitly rather than inventing balancing transactions.

faq.question: Does converting the statements complete the bookkeeping?
faq.answer: No. Extraction prepares data. Duplicate checks, categorization, evidence review and reconciliation are separate steps.

about.title: About StatementXL
about.intro: StatementXL converts bank statement PDFs to spreadsheets with row-level risk flags and source references, so extracted transactions can be checked against the original document.

sections.title: What the product does
sections.text: Upload one PDF and inspect the extracted tables before downloading Excel, CSV, TSV, JSON, Markdown or HTML. Rows are marked OK, DISCREPANCY or UNVERIFIABLE according to the available evidence. OK is not a guarantee of complete or error-free extraction. Current file limits, free allowances and subscription quotas are shown in the converter and plans.

sections.title: Processing and product boundaries
sections.text: The site does not persist statement contents as a document history. Eligible scanned-statement conversions may use an external AI provider under the published privacy policy. Account, billing and operational metadata are separate from statement contents. The product has no direct accounting import, bank connection or public extraction API.

sections.title: Who publishes these guides
sections.text: StatementXL is the product brand and the author/publisher of these guides, comparisons and the public sample report. Sources and actual review dates are shown on each page. Comparisons disclose this affiliation. The official profiles below refer to this brand; no personal founder biography or unverified legal status is asserted.

faq.question: Where can I check the evidence behind a claim?
faq.answer: Follow the source links on the relevant guide and the sample report’s methodology and downloadable results. Contact support for product questions.

checker.title: Free bank statement balance checker and Excel template
checker.intro: Check whether opening balance plus incoming money minus outgoing money equals the closing balance. The calculation runs in your browser without uploading a statement or signing in.

sections.title: Use totals from the same statement
sections.text: Enter the opening and closing balances and the total incoming and outgoing money for one account, one currency and one period. Overdrawn balances can be negative. Enter incoming and outgoing totals as non-negative numbers, with no more than two decimal places.

sections.title: Understand what a difference means
sections.text: Expected closing balance = opening balance + incoming total − outgoing total. Difference = expected closing balance − stated closing balance. A positive difference means the expected balance is higher; a negative difference means it is lower. Check missing fees, interest, transfers, duplicates and period boundaries.

sections.title: A balanced total is only one check
sections.text: Equal totals do not prove that every transaction is present or correctly categorized; errors can offset each other. Compare individual entries and keep the bank-issued statement. The downloadable Excel template uses the same inputs and formulas and is intended for currencies with two decimal places.

faq.question: Are the amounts sent to StatementXL?
faq.answer: No. This checker keeps inputs only in page memory. The downloaded template is a separate local file that you control.

benchmark.title: Public sample report: two statement layouts through the local parser
benchmark.intro: A reproducible check of the Carson Bank public sample and the BHW simulated statement on page 12 of its official guide. These results describe two specific layouts, not general bank support or product-wide accuracy.

sections.title: Method and reference data
sections.text: We downloaded the official PDFs, rendered the selected pages, and transcribed the dated transaction rows before comparing the parser output. Carson uses original pages 1–2; BHW uses original page 12 as a separate input. Opening and closing balance rows are excluded from the reference transaction count. The local Python parser runs directly without AI fallback, user accounts or quota usage.

sections.title: What the row labels do and do not prove
sections.text: OK, DISCREPANCY and UNVERIFIABLE are the parser’s own evidence labels. We report those separately from the manual reference comparison. A row can be marked OK while its description has lost a space, and a balance summary can be returned as an extra row. Review the field checks and extra-row count as well as the status distribution.

sections.title: Limits and reproducibility
sections.text: The samples are public demonstrations, including an older Carson layout and a simulated BHW savings-contract statement. The evaluated pages are a subset of the source documents. This is not a random sample, a scan/OCR test or a comparison against another vendor. The download records source URLs, hashes, selected pages, parser revision and actual measured counts.

faq.question: Does a high OK percentage mean the extraction is accurate?
faq.answer: No. It only means the parser did not flag those extracted rows. Missing rows, extra rows and field mismatches require a separate comparison with the original.

BalanceChecker.title: Balance checker
BalanceChecker.format: Use one currency; up to 12 digits and 2 decimals. No grouping separators.
BalanceChecker.invalid: Enter a valid amount (up to 12 digits and 2 decimals); incoming/outgoing totals must not be negative.
BalanceChecker.balanced: The totals balance. Check individual transactions as well.
BalanceChecker.unbalanced: The totals do not balance. Review the difference.
BalanceChecker.incomplete: Complete all four valid amounts to see the result.
BalanceChecker.privacy: Amounts stay in this page’s memory. No upload, account or amount tracking.
BalanceChecker.templateNote: Same-currency amounts, maximum two decimals. Fill the shaded input cells; formulas update automatically.

Benchmark.title: Public sample results
Benchmark.summary: {layouts} layouts, {pages} selected pages: {reference} reference transactions and {rows} extracted rows; {ok} rows were OK ({percentage} of extracted rows). This is not an accuracy rate.
Benchmark.caption: Status order: OK / DISCREPANCY / UNVERIFIABLE. Counts refer only to the selected pages.
Benchmark.findings: Carson: 11 descriptions lost the space between ACH and DEBIT despite OK status. BHW: the closing-balance summary was returned as one extra UNVERIFIABLE row. No page failures were returned for these selected inputs.
Benchmark.matching: Rows are matched on date, amount and direction, consuming each extracted row once; unmatched reference rows are not necessarily proven omissions. Matched fields normalize whitespace only. The full findings are in the download.
